note: The built core combines this repository's MIT integration with DOSBox-X and is distributed under the GPL-2.0-or-later. The corresponding source of each part is linked below by exact commit.

components.name: chimera-core-dosbox-x (integration)
components.license: MIT, with GPL-2.0-or-later patches, driver and guest tools

components.name: libco's aarch64 switch (from ares)
components.note: extern/vendored/libco/aarch64.c, the cothread switch of the aarch64 package (ares's libco/aarch64.c, written as assembly); the x86_64 package uses amd64.c instead.

components.name: GNU Unifont (FREECG98.BMP, UnifontExMonoAnk.fontx2, UnifontExMonoKanji.fontx2)
components.note: The free fonts DOSBox-X ships in contrib/fonts and looks for by name: the PC-98 character set (rendered from Unifont, dosbox-x issue 2132) and Unifont as FONTX2 for DOS/V and JEGA. Embedded in the core because the sandbox has no disk to keep them on.

components.name: VBADOS 0.67 (VBMOUSE.EXE, VBMOUSE.DRV, OEMSETUP.INF, VBMOUSE.EN)
components.note: The Windows 3.x mouse driver on the Use Chimera Mouse Driver disk, by Javier S. Pedro: the released 0.67 binaries, unmodified, embedded in the core with their source archive (tag v0.67), which is also on the disk as VBADOS.TGZ.
